shard: FrankEye -> Qwen3.5 native vision transition and MVC implications

findings.finding: native_vision.py explicitly says Qwen3.5-4B native multimodal vision replaces FrankEye entirely; it sends image data to local llama-server and returns generated text.
Commit 6158be8d (2026-03-31) rewired visual consumers from FrankEye to native_vision and shifted model recommendations to Qwen3.5 native multimodal vision.

Frozen HEAD still retains frank_eye.py and HOW_IT_WORKS.md describes FrankEye as current, while native_vision.py and multiple current runtime consumers use native_vision. Current repository therefore contains stale/remnant FrankEye surfaces alongside the newer path.
VCB imports native_vision, rate-limits screenshots to 100/day and 20/hour, and stores generated descriptions in world_experience.vcb_observations.
VCB confidence is heuristic 0.7 with anomaly keywords and 0.5 otherwise; it is not calibrated visual identity/open-set confidence.

The inspected native_vision bridge exposes generated text, not a reusable visual embedding API. The current MVC requirement cannot assume cheap deterministic feature vectors are available through this bridge.

disposition.verification_limit: Full recursive call-graph/runtime verification remains open.

mvc_implications: Native multimodal inference is not user-adaptive MVC learning and contains no inspected trust-tier, user-prototype, candidate-promotion, rollback or open-set learner loop.

FrankEye/DINO as MVC backbone is now a candidate, not a settled current-path assumption. H1 should compare retained micro-feature extraction, direct Qwen vision-encoder embeddings, or another frozen micro-backbone.
Generated native-vision text is not a deterministic feature substitute by default.
A calibrated cheap familiarity gate is potentially more valuable in front of Qwen3.5 multimodal generation; unknown/ambiguous/conflict should escalate to native vision.
VCB anomaly confidence, native-model uncertainty, MVC familiarity/open-set confidence and sensor evidence must remain separate typed quantities.
